determinism_level.description: Classification of how reproducible/verifiable this decision is

STRICT_DETERMINISTIC.const: Identical inputs + rules produce identical hash every time. Full replay verification possible.

BOUNDED_DETERMINISTIC.const: Same inputs + rules produce same decision within declared tolerance. Bounded replay verification possible.

HUMAN_GOVERNED.const: Human reviewed inputs and recorded this decision. Governance verification possible, computation replay not possible.

NON_REPLAYABLE.const: Snapshot only at point in time. No replay verification possible.
